chapter_title: Concerning Food: It shall be allocated to Five Pro
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:** The manifold goods and truths that the human spirit receives inwardly and appropriates — taking them into the whole of the mind — these are distributed into five distinct spiritual productions.

**¶3:** The first production is that which proceeds from the spirit as inmost blessedness and ascends into the interior understanding as wisdom; it flows forth from every faculty and capacity of the whole spiritual being, and is without measure or limit.

**¶4:** The second is that which proceeds from the spirit as the affection of truth expressed outwardly — as doctrine spoken and truth confessed.

**¶5:** The third is that which springs forth as the power of good in act — charity exercised through living use and service.

**¶6:** The fourth is that which is generated by the delight of self-love and concupiscence when the will and the understanding turn what they have received toward the proprium — toward selfish and merely natural ends.

**¶7:** The fifth is that which is formed and fashioned in the outermost natural degree alone, and brought forth into the corporeal and sensual life. This is the merely external person as it appears in the world. Only the will and the understanding — the inward faculties that generated it — can recognise this outermost form they have produced. And they attend solely to its cravings, its natural reasoning, and its self-love, continually, at every moment. Yet the four interior productions — inmost blessedness, expressed truth, active good, and even the misdirected desires of the proprium — they neither perceive nor regard at all, because these are not made visible to the outward senses.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: This sustenance of various kinds that people gather in and eat, and enters the body; it shall be distributed to five productions.
The first product is this that shall issue from the person in rapture and rises up in the Mind, and it comes out from all his limbs, and is immeasurable.
The second is this that shall issue from the person in voice and word.
The third is this that shall spring from them in strength and activity.
The fourth is what is engendered by the pleasure of lu[s]t in men and women.

The fifth is this that shall be formed and sculpted in the flesh, and be engendered and come from them. It is this corporeal creature; only its parents can recognise this creature that they beget. They are attentive to its desire and its thought and its [lo]ve every day, all the time. However, these other four forms they neither notice nor are concerned about; because they are not displayed.
